name: Enterprise SRE Incident Response Golden Evaluation Dataset
description: Golden evaluation benchmark for l200-agent covering telemetry triage, runbook search, HITL remediation, and PII redaction.

parts.text: We are seeing high 5xx errors on checkout-service in prod. Query telemetry metrics and find the matching SRE runbook.

Telemetry for `checkout-service` in `prod` confirms a critical anomaly: HTTP 5xx error rate is at 14.8% (SLO < 1.0%), p99 latency is 3420ms, and CPU utilization is saturated at 92.4% following deployment `v2.14.0-canary`. Runbook `RB-101` applies.
